_about: What the engine produces now, format by format: title, subtitle, copy, description and asset sizes. Krish, 2026-10-29: "I think we need to clean up the asset and title, subtitle, copy, descriptions and asset sizes for exactly what we need to be producing now as well, which lives in the content-engine." Every number here is one the code already holds, and tests/control-plane/asset-spec.test.ts fails if the two part: `source` names where. A field that reads null with an `open` note is not set anywhere yet, and only Krish sets it; nothing invents one. Native caption limits on each social platform are Growth's (docs/CAROUSEL-STANDARD.md, Growth's publishing route), not this file's. Readers: scripts/post-pack/asset_spec.py (piece_manifest.py checks asset names against `assets`; scripts/quick-edit/snackable.py takes the off-day snackable's length and frame from `formats.snackable`).
